scope: Canonical cycle2 visual UX quality and responsive accessibility

criteria.description: Two fresh independent I1 blind critics approve the exact Cycle4 production-web candidate at or above the 95 threshold with HIGH confidence and no Critical/High finding
criteria.limitations: Scoped visual judgment only; the reviewers explicitly did not approve the full fourteen-criterion product bar

criteria.description: The exact source/build/render candidate, production functional regression, visual matrix, durable performance records and reduced-motion/axe records reconcile without unexpected or flaky results
criteria.limitations: Local synthetic/loopback Chromium evidence; six declared functional skips remain outside the scoped claim and external services are unavailable

criteria.description: The gate is bounded to the canonical production web slice, records its evidence limitations and preserves the remaining full-product acceptance work
criteria.limitations: No production deployment, external provider/corpus, durability/restore/soak, multi-instance, telemetry, backend performance, clinical validity or final full-product review is claimed

authority.scope: Canonical cycle2 visual UX quality and responsive accessibility
authority.decision: Reversible local scoped acceptance only; no deployment, credentials, clinical claim or high-risk product promotion
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate on canonical web source/build/render changes, contrary evidence or expansion to full-product acceptance

next_action: Pursue the remaining full fourteen-criterion product evidence in an authorized external runtime; retain the scoped web gate as bounded evidence
revalidation_triggers: Canonical web source, production build, visual harness or accessibility contract changes
A new visual or functional regression contradicts the sealed Cycle4 candidate
External runtime, corpus, operations, backend performance, deployment or full-product review scope is introduced
